title: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command（'OS Command Injection') in the ASUS GPU Tweak III…
description: CVE-2026-114203 is a critical OS command injection vulnerability in ASUS GPU Tweak III. It allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands by sending crafted requests to an HTTP endpoint of the service. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of special elements used in OS commands. No affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
